title: Polar Flight Decision — G2 Storm Incoming
description: A G2 geomagnetic storm is forecast to begin within six hours on a busy North America–Asia polar route. Kp is currently 3 but forecast to reach 6. Do you reroute flights southward, or proceed via the polar corridor to save fuel?
historicalOutcome: Dispatchers who rerouted saved fuel costs but avoided the worst HF blackouts. Flights that stayed on the polar route experienced 20–40 minute communication outages.
